definitions.short: a cutting implement , i.e. a blade
definitions.full: H4037. magzerah [ מַגְזֵרָה ] noun feminine cutting instrument, axe — 2Sam 12:31 of David's treatment of captives, הַבַּרְזֶל וּבְמַגְזְרוֺת ֗֗֗ בַּמְּגֵרָה וַיָּשֶׂם . גֵחֲזִי see below גַּיְא גֹּ֫חִי see [ גּוֺחַ גִּיחַ, ]. גחל (probably = kindle, burn ).
